statement:
∀ (f g : ℝ → ℂ),
  Integrable f volume →
    Integrable g volume → ∀ (ξ : ℝ), 𝓕 (f ⋆[ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ, volume] g) ξ = 𝓕 f ξ * 𝓕 g ξ

goal.text: 𝓕 (f ⋆[ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ, volume] g) ξ = 𝓕 f ξ * 𝓕 g ξ
goal.rhs: 𝓕 f ξ * 𝓕 g ξ
goal.lhs: 𝓕 (f ⋆[ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ, volume] g) ξ

atoms: 𝓕 (f ⋆[ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ, volume] g) ξ
